# RapidCAM

> RapidCAM (https://rapidcam.app) is a free, browser-based parametric 2D CAD +
> CAM application for CNC mills, rotary (4th-axis) machines, and lasers. Its
> project format, `.rcam`, is plain JSON with a published JSON Schema, and is
> explicitly designed so that automated tools — including LLMs — can author
> valid design files.

## File format (.rcam)

- [Format guide](https://rapidcam.app/docs/rcam-format-v2.md): the human- and
  AI-readable authoring guide — point-key vocabulary, constraint semantics,
  CAM operations, and gotchas the schema can't express
- [JSON Schema, draft 2020-12](https://rapidcam.app/schema/rcam-v2.schema.json):
  the machine-readable contract (this URL is also the schema's `$id`)
- [Examples index](https://rapidcam.app/examples/index.json): bundled golden
  example projects, each validated against the schema on every commit; fetch
  any listed file at `https://rapidcam.app/examples/<name>`

## Authoring tips for LLMs

- All lengths are millimetres and all angles are radians (CCW), regardless of
  the file's `displayUnit`. The world frame is Y-up.
- You do not need exact coordinates: emit rough positions plus constraints and
  dimensions, and RapidCAM's parametric solver snaps the geometry exact.
- Declare `"version": 2` and validate your output against the schema before
  presenting it to a user.
- Opening a file in RapidCAM reports schema, solver, and CAM lint problems;
  iterate on that feedback rather than aiming for a perfect first attempt.
